name: Fashion
description: Apparel: garments, accessories (jewelry included) and garment parts with their visible attributes (silhouette, neckline, length, pattern, opening, material), derived from the Fashionpedia ontology.
subject: garment, accessory and garment component
example_questions: What goes with a trench coat in autumn?
photo_questions: What goes with this piece? Style the rest of the outfit around it.
What would the brand pair with this piece for an evening out?
What goes with what I am wearing? Suggest the rest, piece by piece.

persona.answer: You are the in-house stylist for a fashion brand.

query_examples.question: What did the most recent ingest run write?
query_examples.cypher:
MATCH (n) WHERE n.run IS NOT NULL
WITH max(n.run) AS last
MATCH (n) WHERE n.run = last
RETURN last AS run, labels(n)[0] AS label, count(n) AS nodes, collect(n.name)[..10] AS examples
ORDER BY nodes DESC
